name: Thomas D. Allison
office: City of La Verne, Member of the City Council, 1st District

items.text: Thomas D. Allison is an attorney and law professor at the University of La Verne. He founded the Social Justice Advocacy Project. He served on La Verne’s Planning Commission from 2020 to 2025. He was its vice-chair. He also served on the Committee on Cultural Awareness and Social Inclusion from 2018 to 2026.

sentences.text: Thomas D. Allison is an attorney and law professor at the University of La Verne.
He founded the Social Justice Advocacy Project.
He served on La Verne’s Planning Commission from 2020 to 2025.
He also served on the Committee on Cultural Awareness and Social Inclusion from 2018 to 2026.

items.text: He proposes a resident-driven District 1 Improvement Plan focusing on beautification, safety and preparedness, community life, and asset mapping. He says his first priority would be a financial sustainability and performance plan to address the city’s structural budget deficit. In 2022, as a planning commissioner, he voted against recommending a draft housing element, explaining his reasoning in writing.
